## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant has a fresh, round, pink-and-white face complemented by jolly brown eyes. Her fair hair is styled into a hard little knob that is secured tightly by an elastic band.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)_

## Personality

A woman known for her bitter tongue paired with a kind heart, Cornelia Bryant is an outspoken individual who often snubs high-falutin language and holds a general disdain for men, remaining ever-ready to sound the alarm where they are concerned. Despite her sharp demeanor and a tendency to be considered cracked on the subject of [Methodists](../codex/factions.md#methodist), she privately acknowledges herself to be a lonely soul who prefers to avoid useless arguments and enjoys reading obituary notices for recreation. Extremely neat in her habits, she is an exceptionally talented cook who frequently prepares nice food for others, having even won a prize for her lemon pies. Additionally, she takes quiet pride in her abilities as the best sewer in the local area, skilled in both sewing and hand embroidery.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), +7 more_

## History

As an only child for eight years who had her pick of suitors in her youth, Miss Cornelia Bryant established herself in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) as a sharp, highly opinionated woman known for her frank views on local neighbors, church denominations, and men. Thirteen years prior to [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's move to the harbor, she married [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), becoming Mrs. Marshall Elliott. Shortly after meeting [Anne](../character/anne.md), Cornelia recounted the tragic history of their neighbor, [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), encouraging [Anne](../character/anne.md) to pursue a friendship with the lonely woman despite her guarded demeanor. When Anne's husband, Dr. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), proposed a surgical procedure to restore memory to Leslie's brain-damaged husband [Dick](../character/dick.md), Cornelia voiced fierce disapproval of the idea; however, following the operation, she was astonished to learn that the man was actually Dick's cousin [George](../character/george.md) and that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) was officially free. Following a local federal election, Cornelia revealed her surprise decision to marry her longtime suitor, [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md). Years later, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) returned from a trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), Cornelia rescued young [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md) from an encounter with [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md). Upon discovering that Mary was an orphan left destitute by her guardian's death, Cornelia consulted with [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) and agreed to adopt the girl. In the following years, Cornelia frequently visited [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to discuss parish business, gossip about local scandals involving the minister's mischievous children, and vent her initial exasperation over the family's antics. However, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) passionately defended the minister's family, Cornelia shifted her stance to champion the children's unique strengths, eventually joining her friends in celebrating the upcoming double wedding of the minister and his bride.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), +1130 more_

## Quotes

> "I have the Methodist minister’s word for it—if you call THAT proof. Robert Baxter told me the same thing too, but I admit THAT isn’t evidence. Robert Baxter isn’t often known to tell the truth."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P16](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0016)

> "You always look as cool as a cucumber, Anne, dearie. Do I smell cherry pie? If I do, ask me to stay to tea. Haven’t tasted a cherry pie this summer. My cherries have all been stolen by those scamps of Gilman boys from the Glen."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P12](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0012)

> "There’s a great change come over her lately. She laughs and jokes like a girl, and from her talk I gather she’s here real often."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "Now, you needn’t Miss Cornelia me, Anne, dearie. ANYBODY would have thought the same. If the Montreal doctors can make a rational creature out of Dick Moore they’re wonders."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P4](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0004)

> "Yes. They run up just like the steps of a stair. Gerald’s the oldest. He’s twelve and they call him Jerry. He’s a clever boy. Faith is eleven. She is a regular tomboy but pretty as a picture, I must say."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--cornelia-bryant.md)

Miss Cornelia first called on [Anne](../character/anne.md) during her honeymoon at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), bringing her sewing and sharing her sharp, unvarnished opinions on men, local neighbors, and church politics. Despite their differences in age and perspective, the two developed a warm acquaintance through Miss Cornelia's frequent visits. Miss Cornelia often acts as an informant on local affairs, confiding sensitive matters to [Anne](../character/anne.md), such as the painful history of their tragic neighbor [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md).

- Friend of — kindred spirits and friends  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), +5 more</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

Miss Cornelia acts as a protective, caring friend and neighbor to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). Knowing Leslie's tragic childhood and difficult domestic situation, Miss Cornelia actively looks out for her well-being and vouches for her character. She actively encourages other neighbors, including [Anne](../character/anne.md), to look past Leslie's distant and cold demeanor to establish a supportive friendship with her.

- Friend of — caring friend and neighbor  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029), +1 more</sub>

### [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--marshall.md)

[Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) and Miss Cornelia became betrothed and subsequently married after a prolonged delay. Following their marriage, they settle into household life together, with Miss Cornelia consulting [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) on major domestic decisions. This includes their joint choice to adopt the young orphan [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) into their home.

- Romantically involved with — betrothed / going to be married  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--cornelia-bryant.md)

Miss Cornelia maintains a close friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), frequently dropping by [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to visit and trade local gossip. Their relationship is characterized by comfortable, frequent chats on the veranda alongside [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md), where Miss Cornelia keeps [Anne](../character/anne.md) informed on all the latest happenings in the community.

- Friend of — close friend and frequent visitor (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007)</sub>

### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--john-meredith.md)

Miss Cornelia maintains a friendly relationship with the local [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister, Mr. [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), though she frequently scrutinizes his household management and his children's upbringing. She takes a direct interest in his affairs, such as confronting him about Mary Vance's background, while remaining a good friend to him and discussing his family's antics with mutual acquaintances.

- Friend of — good friends (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P3](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0003)</sub>
